autoContact.title: Auto-Contact
autoContact.summary: Android mobile app built with React Native / Expo SDK 56 that syncs contacts from a REST API to the device address book. Includes foreground and background auto-sync, persistent settings, API pagination, and unit tests.
autoContact.description: Android app designed to automate importing WhatsApp contacts from an external backend. The app compares phone numbers with the local address book and only creates new contacts, avoiding duplicates. The architecture separates actions, services, and composite hooks; state persists in AsyncStorage. The scheduler coordinates manual sync, configurable timers, background tasks, and re-sync when the app is reopened.
highlights: Modular architecture with composite hooks (`useSyncOrchestrator`) orchestrating permissions, settings, sync, and scheduler.
REST integration with sequential pagination (500 records/page), deduplication, and fail-fast error handling.
Multi-channel auto-sync: foreground (1 min–1 h interval), background (min. 15 min on Android), and resume on app reopen.
In-app Settings panel: server URL, API key, log limit, interval, and connection test.
Local persistence with AsyncStorage and real-time activity logs.
Jest tests for the fetch layer (multi-page, dedupe, errors).
Release build with EAS (optimized APK: minify, shrink resources, arm64).

screenshots.logs: Activity logs and sync status screen

congressoTerciarios.title: Congresso Terciarios
congressoTerciarios.summary: Offline-first Flutter app for QR attendance control at congresses: Hive + hybrid sync (foreground/background) with MySQL and Docker.
congressoTerciarios.description: Flutter app for attendance control at a congress with hundreds of participants. It scans QR codes at each event entrance, works offline with Hive, and bidirectionally syncs with MySQL when online. Includes foreground sync (after QR, on reconnect, every ~5 min), Workmanager in the background (~15 min), and a visible sync status bar (synced / pending / syncing / error).
highlights: Flutter QR attendance app with offline mode (Hive) and bidirectional MySQL sync.
Hybrid sync: auto-sync after scan/reconnect, periodic foreground sync, and Workmanager in the background.
Layered architecture (`app` / `core` / `data` / `presentation`) with sync state orchestration visible in the UI.
MySQL 8 with Docker Compose, schema, event seed, and CSV participant import.
Sync lock to avoid race conditions between UI and background tasks.
Usable startup with local data even when MySQL is unavailable.

evangelhoDiario.title: Evangelho Diário
evangelhoDiario.summary: Flutter app in production (iOS/Android) for daily gospel, prayers, and rosary. First version + maintenance and technical evolution.
evangelhoDiario.description: Catholic mobile app in Flutter with daily gospel, prayers, rosary, and intention submissions. I built the first version and later took over maintenance and technical evolution in production. Most of the current UI was redesigned by other collaborators; my focus was architecture, data, integrations, and store releases.
highlights: First version of the app and product continuity on stores (iOS/Android).
Migration from Firestore to MySQL, .env configuration, and local Docker environment.
Firebase Analytics integration and iOS/Android project configuration.
Stability improvements (global messaging, sync, builds) and release process.
